name: Foraging, Harvesting, Hunting Yield & Food Acquisition Runtime
design_rules: food acquisition draws from explicit world resource nodes
yield depends on resource abundance season skill and tool method
harvest removes resource abundance instead of creating ingredients from nothing
resource nodes recover over time according to regrowth rate
overharvesting lowers future yields and may temporarily exhaust a node
hunting and fishing may have nonzero risk and disturbance
seasonality changes availability without hard mission locks
food acquisition state persists across world days
food acquisition never uses emissive or glow feedback
